sources.snippet: Model Card for smolvla SmolVLA is a compact, efficient vision-language-action model that achieves competitive performance at reduced computational costs and can be deployed on consumer-grade hardware. This policy has been trained and pushed to the Hub using LeRobot. See the full documentation at LeRobot Docs.

sources.snippet: SmolVLA on SO-101: Pick-and-Place with Vision-Language-Action Models A complete pipeline for teaching a SO-101 robot arm to pick up a box and place it in the correct colored bowl using SmolVLA (Vision-Language-Action model) with natural language instructions.

sources.title: Train an SO-101 Robot From Sim-to-Real With NVIDIA Isaac
sources.snippet: You'll train and deploy a vision-language-action (VLA) model to perform unstructured pick-and-place of centrifuge vials into a rack using an SO-101 robot arm - first in sim, where we can iterate quickly and validate behavior, then in reality.
